## L1 Capability: Security Operations

Security Operations is the enterprise capability responsible for the continuous detection, analysis, response to, and recovery from cybersecurity events across Gainwell's environments. It represents the operational and analytical layer of the enterprise security architecture — providing situational awareness, threat visibility, and structured response coordination that complements preventive controls in adjacent security domains (Identity, Network, Application, Data, and Cloud Security). The SecOps capability operates under the enterprise principle of Assume Breach: its design presumes that preventive controls will be circumvented and focuses on minimizing the impact and duration of security events.

## L2 Capability Areas

| L2 Capability | Description | Maturity |
|---|---|---|
| Security Monitoring & Detection | The capability to collect, normalize, correlate, and analyze security telemetry from across the enterprise to identify events and behaviors warranting investigation or response. | Developing |
| Threat Intelligence & Hunting | The capability to ingest, operationalize, and act on threat intelligence — including indicators of compromise, adversary TTPs, and emerging threat context — and to proactively search for undetected threats within the environment. | Initial |
| Incident Response & Recovery | The capability to detect, triage, contain, eradicate, and recover from security incidents in a structured, documented manner, including stakeholder communication and post-incident review. | Developing |
| Vulnerability & Exposure Management | The capability to continuously discover, assess, prioritize, and coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities and attack surface exposures across enterprise assets. | Developing |
| Security Orchestration & Automation | The capability to automate repetitive SecOps workflows, orchestrate cross-tool response actions, and reduce mean time to respond through playbook-driven automation. | Initial |
| Digital Forensics & Evidence Management | The capability to acquire, preserve, and analyze digital evidence from security incidents in a manner that supports investigation, root cause analysis, and legal or regulatory obligations. | Initial |
| Security Analytics & Reporting | The capability to aggregate, measure, and communicate security operational performance, risk posture, and compliance status to operational, executive, and regulatory audiences. | Initial |

## Scope and Boundaries

**In Scope**:
- Detection and response operations across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments
- Threat intelligence operationalization and proactive hunting
- Structured incident lifecycle management from detection through recovery
- Vulnerability discovery, risk-based prioritization, and remediation coordination
- Playbook-driven workflow automation for SecOps processes
- Digital evidence acquisition and forensic investigation support
- Security metrics collection and audience-driven reporting

**Out of Scope**:
- Identity and access management operations (see Identity Security capability map)
- Network perimeter and firewall management (see Cloud & Infrastructure Security capability map)
- Application security testing and SAST/DAST operations (see Application Security capability map)
- Physical security operations
- Non-cyber operational risks

**Non-ABB Guardrail**: This document defines capabilities at L1/L2 only. Architecture Building Blocks, solution patterns, security controls, vendor selections, and compliance requirements are explicitly out of scope for this artifact.
